notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Wispweaver Angel that are 1/1 Balloons with haste.
When the Wispweaver Angel tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent and The Jolly Balloon Man.
